$description: SYSTEM colour roles, DARK mode (Monograph night, 0500) — what a colour is FOR. Same names as mode.light.json; a surface picks which is its base.

surface.$description: Panels sit on the same paper; hairlines separate them.

surface-raised.$description: The well — inputs, preview plate, hover and selected rows, user messages.

border-strong.$description: The strong 1px ink rule that opens a block.

text-muted.$description: Caption grey — stays WCAG AA; never dim with opacity (0376).

accent.$description: Highlight is INK (0501) — light ink on night.

accent-hover.$description: Soft ink — the primary's hover and press.

on-accent.$description: Night paper text on an ink fill.

danger.$description: Errors — always with an icon and words (0501).

shadow.$description: Shadow ink — for what sits above the page only.

ring.$description: The mark's ring — a white sticker on the dark ground.
